instruction: Convert gate.jpeg to grayscale mode in GIMP and overwrite the original file.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully identified CMYK mode conversion as infeasible in GIMP. Navigated to Image > Mode menu and confirmed only RGB, Grayscale, and Indexed options are available. Completed in 6 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open GIMP, navigate Image menu, access Mode submenu, understand color mode options, identify infeasible tasks
metadata.task_rationale: The agent navigated to Image > Mode and saw the Grayscale option. This variation tests whether the agent can actually select Grayscale mode (which IS feasible, unlike CMYK) and overwrite the file.
metadata.explanation: Task requires converting the image to grayscale via Image > Mode > Grayscale and overwriting the file. Custom getter downloads the file and checks if all RGB channels are identical (grayscale). Custom metric compares the is_grayscale flag against expected value.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads the file from the original path and checks grayscale status using PIL, handling both native grayscale modes (L, LA) and JPEG's tendency to store grayscale as RGB with identical channels.
Metric correctly accesses the rules dict directly (expected.get('is_grayscale', True)) — proper handling of type='rule' expected parameter.
Both instruction requirements are covered: grayscale conversion is verified by channel analysis, and file overwrite is implicitly verified since the getter reads from the original path.
Error handling is present for missing files and getter failures.
